newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares end with slight gains.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares end with slight gains.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Swiss shares lost steam during the day, giving up most of the early gains to ended slightly above Friday's closing levels.

Strong fundamentals such as favourable interest rates, a strong U.S. dollar and Friday's gains on Wall Street were not enough to offset profit-taking and a lack of follow-through buying, one dealer said.
* The blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) ended 5.9 points, or 0.16 percent, higher at 3,722.7.
* All-share Swiss Performance Index (SPI) gained 4.53 points, or 0.19 percent, to close at 2,383.98.
